# External reference material

## podobnik2020_suppfig5_kcnj13_alignment.png

Supplementary Figure 5 from Podobnik M, Frohnhöfer HG, Dooley CM, Eskova A, Nüsslein-Volhard C,
Irion U. *Evolution of the potassium channel gene Kcnj13 underlies colour pattern diversification
in Danio fish.* Nat Commun 2020;11:6230. doi:10.1038/s41467-020-20021-6

Open access (CC BY 4.0). Retrieved from the publisher's supplementary material for
residue-level comparison with our Kcnj13 result (Results §3.2). Held here for reproducibility
of that comparison only; the figure remains the authors' work under its original licence.

**What it shows.** A nine-species Kcnj13 alignment. Residues that evolved between *D. rerio* and
*D. aesculapii* are magenta; *D. rerio* polymorphisms dark grey; known *D. rerio* Kcnj13 mutations
blue; M1/M2 and the H5 P-loop shaded.

**Comparison with this study** (their numbering runs +4 relative to ours, because their
*D. rerio* sequence includes the N-terminal MPTT that RefSeq NP_001039014.2 lacks):

| Podobnik et al. | This work | Agreement |
|---|---|---|
| Q23L | Q19L | identical |
| D180G | D176G | identical |
| R244K | absent (both RefSeq entries carry R at our position 240) | sequence-source difference |
